text:
zoe (Product): Heads-up: during usability testing the Create API Key flow broke for teams with many roles. The multiselect becomes a vertical scroll and users lose the "applies to key" signal.

cal (PM): yep—we've seen two support tickets where people assumed the roles were tied to their user account. Small copy fix could reduce confusion. Suggestion: add 'These roles are granted to this API key.' under the picker.

ryan (Frontend): can reproduce keyboard-wise: tab into the chip list -> arrow nav -> focus gets stuck inside the virtualized list. Also there's no explicit remove control accessible by keyboard (backspace only which isn't discoverable).

meera (A11y): confirmed on VoiceOver. Chips read as plain text; need: 1) an aria-live polite region saying "N roles selected" on change, 2) each chip has a labelled remove button e.g. "Remove role analytics.read", and 3) ensure the Show/Hide secret toggle has an accessible name + aria-pressed.

zoe (Product): design idea: show up to 5 pills inline then a "+N" overflow button that opens a small modal with the full list + checkboxes. Also include the one-line clarifier next to the picker: "These roles apply to this API key." Keeps the modal tidy.

cal (PM): when admin.* or wildcard scopes are selected we should show an inline banner (icon + orange tint). Current inline text is too faint. Banner should be one line: "Warning: This key grants broad access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services." with a tiny disclosure "why" that reveals one-sentence rationale.

ryan (Frontend): implementation notes: condensed pills via CSS; "+N" is a real button that opens role=dialog with focus trap. I'll rework keyboard handlers so list container manages arrow keys and allows tabbing out. Will add telemetry fields: create_modal_open, create_submit, overflow_open, banner_ack.

meera (A11y): prefer a custom disclosure component so we can control aria-expanded and announcements. Ensure the dialog receives initial focus and announces a title. Contrast note: orange bg + small caption may fail AA, increase weight or darken text.

zoe (Product): draft microcopy for the banner: 
"Warning: This key grants wide access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services. Limit scopes and rotate keys regularly."

cal (PM): nice. Keep the inline "why" so users don't leave the flow for docs. Also track banner_ack telemetry when users dismiss/ack the banner.

ryan (Frontend): going to add labelled remove controls, aria-live region, and dialog focus trap. Branch: fix/api-keys-overflow. I'll include data-testid for QA.

ci-bot: build started for branch "fix/api-keys-overflow"  running unit + accessibility suites. link: https://ci.internal/reports/999

meera (A11y): quick PR checklist:
- aria-live announces role count on change
- remove buttons labelled and reachable by tab
- "+N" button announces count and opens dialog with focus
- dialog title announced and close button labelled
- warning banner contrast & focus styles validated
- show-secret toggle has accessible name + aria-pressed

zoe (Product): action items:
1) ryan: implement condensed pills + overflow dialog + keyboard fixes + telemetry (PR by Thu)
2) meera: draft a11y copy & test checklist (review Wed)
3) cal: telemetry spec + inline disclosure wording
4) zoe: update empty state: "No API keys yet 61 create your first key" and mock the condensed pills

cal (PM): follow-up: rotation UX should surface role assignments and show a small timeline when a key is rotated. let's keep that as a subsequent ticket.

ryan (Frontend): noted. will make role assignment payload idempotent on rotate to preserve mapping.

ci-bot: build completed for "fix/api-keys-overflow"  5 tests failing (a11y). details: https://ci.internal/reports/999#failures

meera (A11y): i'll triage the accessibility failures (probably focus order & missing live-region updates). Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
